node.statement: If e<=min{e_co,1}, then lem-compcb-rectangular-product and ||AB||<=(1+epsilon)||A||||B|| imply ||A dot B||<=(1+epsilon+C_co*e)||A||||B||<=K_0||A||||B|| with K_0=2+C_co. For a square-by-column pair, node 1.1.2 gives q_P(A dot X)<=2||A dot X||<=2K_0||A||||X||<=4K_0||A||q_R(X)=K_mul||A||q_R(X).
